['Lekkerland SE & Co. KG '].company_description: Lekkerland SE & Co. KG is a trading company and the exclusive supply partner for the majority of the product ranges stocked in stores across Aral's network of 1,200 company-owned retail sites in Germany. It is part of the REWE group and offers innovative services, tailor-made logistics, and a wide range of wholesale products to customers in four European countries.

['Trianel GmbH '].company_description: Trianel GmbH is an offshore wind service company headquartered in Bremerhaven, Germany. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Siemens Gamesa. The company is involved in designing, assembling, and installing wind turbines for offshore wind farms, as well as manufacturing rotor blades through its subsidiary Adwen Blades GmbH.
